attributes.name: Product
attributes.description: The canonical product node.

attributes.name: Product status
attributes.description: Whether the product is offered.

attributes.name: Legal entity
attributes.description: The institution legal entity that provides the product.

attributes.name: Booking entity
attributes.description: Where the relationship is booked.

attributes.name: Business unit
attributes.description: The business line that owns the offering.

attributes.name: Eligible party types
attributes.description: Party classifications the offering may serve.

attributes.name: Regulatory regime
attributes.description: The regime under which the offering is provided.

attributes.name: Booking jurisdiction
attributes.description: ISO country where the relationship is booked.

attributes.name: Customer jurisdictions
attributes.description: Countries the customer is resident in or established in.

attributes.name: Transaction jurisdictions
attributes.description: Countries funds or assets move to or from.

attributes.name: Account arrangement
attributes.description: How the account is held: an arrangement, not a product.

attributes.name: Ownership and control roles
attributes.description: Beneficial owners, controllers, trustees, signatories and authorised traders.

attributes.name: Funding methods
attributes.description: How the relationship is funded.

attributes.name: Third-party funding
attributes.description: Whether a party other than the customer may fund it.

attributes.name: Expected monthly value
attributes.description: Expected value moved per month.

attributes.name: Expected monthly transactions
attributes.description: Expected number of transactions per month.

attributes.name: Counterparty types
attributes.description: Kinds of counterparties expected.

attributes.name: Payment corridors
attributes.description: Expected origin–destination country pairs.

attributes.name: Access channels
attributes.description: How the product is accessed.

attributes.name: Non-face-to-face onboarding
attributes.description: Whether customers may onboard without meeting in person.

attributes.name: Credit exposure
attributes.description: Whether the institution extends credit.

attributes.name: Leverage
attributes.description: Whether margin or leverage is available.

attributes.name: Collateral
attributes.description: Collateral taken, if any.

attributes.name: Custody of assets
attributes.description: Whether the institution holds client assets.

attributes.name: Intermediaries
attributes.description: Introducing brokers, correspondents, custodians or payment facilitators involved.

attributes.name: Nested access
attributes.description: Whether the intermediary's own customers transact through the relationship.

attributes.name: Currencies
attributes.description: Currencies the product holds or moves.

attributes.name: Asset types
attributes.description: Instruments or assets involved, by canonical instrument class.

attributes.name: Asset transferability
attributes.description: How readily held value can be transferred to others.

attributes.name: Cross-border exposure
attributes.description: Whether the relationship involves other jurisdictions.

attributes.name: Ownership complexity
attributes.description: Whether ownership is layered, nominee or otherwise opaque.

attributes.name: Cash intensity
attributes.description: Share of activity expected in physical cash.

attributes.name: Monitoring profile
attributes.description: Transaction monitoring scenarios that apply.

attributes.name: Periodic review interval
attributes.description: Months between periodic reviews, set by policy.

attributes.name: Lifecycle stage
